MarketDuel — a pricing tool for EVE Online

Two markets compete for your business. The ★ marks the winner.

From a hangar

Open your ship's hangar or a station's item hangar.

  • Ctrl + A: select all
  • Ctrl + click: add one item
  • Shift + click: select everything between two items

Then Ctrl + C to copy.

From a ship fit

A saved fit: Neocom › Ship › Fitting Management. Select the fit, click (right of Simulate), then Copy to Clipboard.

The fit on screen: Fitting window (Alt + F). Click (left of the rig slots), then (right of Browse), then Copy to Clipboard.

Every item gets a count (x1 if none was given). You can edit any count.

2. Sell or Buy?

3. Choose two markets

4.

Winner takes all

★ marks the winning price. More stars mean a bigger difference between the two markets: ★★ 50k ISK or more, ★★★ 100k or more. Gold stars are Big wins: ★ 1M or more, ★★ 5M or more, ★★★ 10M or more. Point at any price to see the exact price and difference.

If MarketDuel helped earn or save you some ISK, an in-game tip to Axiiom Jones would be appreciated. Fly safe! o7

No Market Duel accounts, no cookies, no tracking. Prices come directly from EVE Online's market data via ESI, EVE's official API. Signing in with EVE is optional. Sign-in happens securely on CCP's own login site, which grants Market Duel permission to search the citadel markets your character can access. Your sign-in is saved only in your browser. No website other than CCP's is queried.
